mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (fp.person_id) fp.id AS faceProfileId, fp.person_id AS personId, p.display_name AS displayName, p.person_type::text AS personKind, fp.image_url AS imageUrl, (fp.embedding <=> #{embedding}::vector) AS distance, (1 - (fp.embedding <=> #{embedding}::vector)) AS score FROM face_profiles fp JOIN persons p ON p.id = fp.person_id WHERE fp.embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fp.person_id, fp.quality_score DESC NULLS LAST, fp.id ) best WHERE best.distance <= #{maxDistance} ORDER BY best.distance LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO face_profiles (person_id, embedding, image_url, quality_score, created_at) VALUES (#{personId}, #{embedding}::vector, #{imageUrl}, #{qualityScore}, NOW())
